spans.s:
r. 1st cl. (लयते)
To go, to move.

m. (-यः)
1 Equal time in music and dancing.
2 Adhering or clinging to, embracing, uniting.
3 A house, a dwelling.
4 Sport, pastime.
n. (-यं)
1 The root of the Andropogon muricatum.
2 Loss, destruction.
3 Fusion, melting.
E.
ली to adhere to, &c., aff. अच्.

f. (-त्त्री)
An actress, a dancer.
E.
लय equal time in music, &c., and पुत्त्री the daughter.

m. (-म्बः)
An actor, a dancer, a mime.
E.
लय equal time, &c., and आलम्ब who moves to; it also occurs लयारम्भ.
